name: Localyze
what: Global-mobility software for employers: visas, relocation and cross-border hiring compliance for international staff.
homonym_note: Not the Indian media firm Localyze (Alchemy Group, 2019 Google News hit).

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); press names Visionaries Club among the investors in the Sept 2022 Series B.
membership.quote: Among them are U.S. VC firm General Catalyst. the Visionaries Club, Web Summit Fund

entry.quote: close a 35 million US dollars Series B round

status.event: Acquired by Boundless Immigration (Seattle); terms not disclosed

valuation.quote: No priced valuation published for any round; acquisition price not disclosed.

notes: Entry: Visionaries is not named in the July 2021 $12M Series A (UKTN names Blossom, Frontline and angels, including Personio's Hanno Renner, a Visionaries founder-LP, as a personal angel), so the Sept 2022 Series B is its first round; deutsche-startups.de (2022-09-07) lists 'General Catalyst, Visionaries Club, Web Summit Fund und Frontline Ventures'. Lead: Personalwirtschaft (2022-09-12) says 'Die Finanzierung von Localyze führt General Catalyst als Investor an' and 'Außerdem investieren Visionaries Club, Web Summit Fund, Frontline Ventures' (https://www.personalwirtschaft.de/news/hr-organisation/hr-start-up-localyze-erhaelt-35-millionen-us-dollar-142115/). Status: Boundless announced the acquisition on 2025-10-01 (its own release, dateline Seattle); agrees with both siblings (acquired). The release calls Localyze 'backed by General Catalyst and Y Combinator'. Vehicle hint inferred from Series B stage and 2022 date. WebSearch used once to find the Series B.
